$comment: Single source of truth for what rxova.org is assembled from. Adding a project is ONE entry here
plus a matching entry in @rxova/brand's PROJECTS (which the docs sites need for the project
switcher). Nothing in .github/workflows changes: deploy.yml builds its matrix from this file.
Paths are DERIVED from `id` by scripts/registry.mjs and must not be written here:
id: "foo"  ->  base /packages/foo/ · mount packages/foo · artifact docs-foo · checkout dir foo
`enabled` gates the project everywhere at once — CI build, mount, and the landing's Docs link.
It lives in git rather than in a repo variable so the site's contents are reviewable in a PR
and visible in `git log`, instead of being invisible state in the repo settings.
`build` runs in the project's checkout with DOCS_BASE_URL set to its derived base; the commands
are interpolated into the workflow's `run:`, so they carry the same trust as deploy.yml itself.
`output` is the directory that build produces, relative to the project's repo root, already laid
out to match its base URL — the aggregator only relocates it, it never rewrites asset paths.

landing.blurb: Model multi-step, branching flows as a graph instead of a tangle of booleans and effects. Core is framework-agnostic; React bindings and a Chrome DevTools bridge come in the box.

sources.$comment: turbo build (@rxova/docs) builds prerequisite packages first via dependsOn; DOCS_URL/DOCS_BASE_URL are in turbo's cache key upstream.

landing.blurb: A family of focused input components — localized currency, OTP slots, and feedback stars — each zero-to-few dependencies, accessible, and free of the usual cursor and locale bugs.

sources.$comment: Astro/Starlight emits dist/, not build/. The docs render mermaid to static SVG at build time via rehype-mermaid, which drives headless chromium — so the browser has to be installed here as well as in the project's own CI, or the diagrams degrade and the build produces nothing to upload.

landing.blurb: Share state and messages across every tab, window, and worker — a framework-agnostic core plus React bindings, one small API.
